name: g-world
description: G WORLD — educational platform teaching students about fields of study, courses, lessons and certifications.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @g-world/shared && npm run typecheck -w @g-world/api && npm run typecheck:js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply g_world --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply g_world --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrations:list: wrangler d1 migrations list g_world --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.verify: npm run check:config && npm run check:lock && npm run check:structure && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.deploy:api: npm run check:config && npm run deploy -w @g-world/api
